summary: Starbucks Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the settlement of its previously announced cash tender offers for several series of its senior notes. The company accepted for purchase $1.32 billion aggregate principal amount across six series, paying total consideration including accrued interest. Certain series (4.000% due 2028, 4.900% due 2031, 4.800% due 2033) were not tendered. This is a routine liability management transaction, not a special situation. The filing confirms completion on the early settlement date with no further purchases anticipated.
